description: Risk R-B before anything else, because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is TransactionAddController, and this program adds nothing - it VIEWS. Four independent artefacts say so. app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 reads 'Function : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file'. README.md:314 reads '| CT01 | COTRN01 | COTRN01C | Transaction View |'. app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 reads 'CardDemo - Transaction View'. And the screen says it to the operator directly, in the INITIAL='View Transaction' literal at POS=(4,30) [app/bms/COTRN01.bms:75-79]. The mapset settles it structurally as well: 56 DFHMDF entries, 21 of them named, and exactly ONE UNPROT - TRNIDIN at :85, ATTRB=(FSET,IC,NORM,UNPROT) COLOR=GREEN HILIGHT=UNDERLINE LENGTH=16 POS=(6,21) - so a single input-capable field faces twenty output-only ones, which is the shape of a lookup-then-display screen and not of a data-entry screen. Rule R1 resolves the collision - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so it is documented here and never silently corrected. No arm of this case asserts an insert, expectedWrites is empty, and the half of the swap that genuinely adds a transaction lives in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: the not-found rejection on the re-entry path, reached AFTER the thirteen-field blanking and AFTER the keyed read. EIBCALEN is 218, so :94 takes its else arm and :98 copies the passed area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives at 1, so CDEMO-PGM-REENTER already holds at :99 and control takes the ELSE at :110-111 rather than the first-entry arm - which is why the echoed context is still 1 and why the :100 SET and the :101 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN1AO never run here. :111 performs RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN [:230-238, RECEIVE MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') INTO(COTRN1AI)], then the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :112 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER, and performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. There the EVALUATE TRUE at :146 takes its SECOND arm - WHEN OTHER at :153-155 - because the key is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES: -1 goes to TRNIDINL and control continues with WS-ERR-FLG still 'N'. :158 IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is therefore TRUE, which is the whole reason this case exists: the thirteen-item blanking of :159-171 RUNS, the MOVE TRNIDINI TO TRAN-ID of :172 runs, and READ-TRANSACT-FILE is performed at :173. The keyed read at :269-278 - EXEC CICS READ DATASET(WS-TRANSACT-FILE) INTO(TRAN-RECORD) RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF TRAN-ID) UPDATE - is issued against three seeded rows whose TRAN-IDs are 0000000000000001, 0000000000000002 and 0000000000000003, none of which is the 0000000000009999 this case looks up, so the EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :280 takes its SECOND arm, WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) at :283-288: WS-ERR-FLG becomes 'Y', 'Transaction ID NOT found...' goes to WS-MESSAGE, -1 goes to TRNIDINL again and the screen is sent ONCE. :176 is then false, so the thirteen record-to-screen moves of :177-190 and the second send at :191 are skipped - which matters, because a translation that painted detail over a rejection would be caught by exactly nothing else. The task ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) of :136-139. WHICH ARM OF :147 THIS CASE TAKES, AND WHY IT IS NOT THE ONE THE FILE-LEVEL BRIEF NAMED. The brief for case07 asked it to pin the LOW-VALUES operand of 'WHEN TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES' [:147] on the stated premise that case06 pinned the SPACES operand. That premise does not hold against the fixtures as they stand, and the disagreement is disclosed here rather than resolved silently (practice B4). case05 pins the SPACES operand - sixteen blank bytes, x'20' under the US-ASCII code page these cases name and x'40' on the EBCDIC one - and case06 pins the LOW-VALUES operand - sixteen x'00' bytes, which is the same byte on either code page and is what a 3270 sends for a field the operator never typed into. Both halves of the TRUE side are therefore already pinned, and re-pinning LOW-VALUES here would have produced a fixture identical to case06 in every member but its identifier, which would have spent one of exactly twenty slots on a duplicate and left the FALSE side of that same condition pinned by nothing. A compound condition needs three states to be covered, not two: TRUE by the first operand (case05), TRUE by the second (case06) and FALSE (this case). This case is that third state, so the trio completes the condition in the sense the branch gate measures, whereas a clone would have completed nothing. It is also the state case05 and case06 both name in their own descriptions as the far half of a deliberate pair - the same value is typed into TDESCI in all three, and it survives to TDESCO in case05 and case06 because :159-171 was skipped there, while here it comes back blank because :159-171 ran. That difference is what locates the blanking, and a translation that blanked in the wrong place would satisfy one of the pair and fail the other. THE TWENTY-ONE RECEIVED ITEMS, AND WHY ALL OF THEM ARE SUPPLIED. RECEIVE MAP fills COTRN1AI, and 01 COTRN1AO REDEFINES COTRN1AI makes the input and output views one buffer - so what the program does not overwrite, it sends back. Supplying all twenty-one xxxI items therefore turns one send into four separate proofs. The six header items arrive stale - 'XX99', '01/01/01', 'STALEPGM', '11:11:11' and two 'STALE TITLE' strings - and come back as what POPULATE-HEADER-INFO rebuilt at :247-262: TITLE01O is CCDA-TITLE01 and TITLE02O is CCDA-TITLE02, both PIC X(40) with their leading and trailing spaces inside the field, and TITLE02O takes the ACTIVE app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:22 value rather than the commented-out :21 alternative; TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CT01' and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COTRN01C', both from :36-37; CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are PINNED (practice B7) to the instant the source's own footer at :329 carries, 2022-07-19 23:12:34, because MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :245 is otherwise the one non-deterministic statement in the program. The thirteen detail items arrive carrying distinct stale values and come back as spaces at their declared widths, which pins the blanking list of :159-171 item by item rather than sampling it. TRNIDINO comes back as the sixteen characters this case supplied, because :159-171 does not name it - the lookup field keeps what the operator typed even when the lookup fails, which is what lets them correct it. And ERRMSGO arrives stale and comes back carrying the rejection message, because :91-92 blanks it at entry and :217 moves WS-MESSAGE over it. THE TWO MESSAGE CHANNELS are declared separately at their own widths because :217 moves WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) and COBOL loses the two rightmost bytes. Both images are the same 27-character literal - note the upper-case NOT and the three trailing dots - space-filled to 80 and to 78 respectively, so the truncation is observable rather than hidden inside a single channel. ERRMSGO is pinned at 78, never 80. There is no DISPLAY line: the program's only DISPLAY is at :290, inside the WHEN OTHER arm of the read, and this case reaches the NOTFND arm instead - case08 is the one that reaches :290. THE HIGHLIGHT, and why an empty attribute map is the assertion rather than an omission: gate G38 asks that field highlighting apply only in REENTER state, and COTRN01C satisfies it in the strongest available form by applying none in EITHER state. It does not copy CSSETATY - its eight COPY statements at :52-72 are COCOM01Y, COTRN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and it declares no FLG-<field>-NOT-OK or FLG-<field>-BLANK pair for a resolver to act on, so no DFHRED reaches TRNIDINC and no '*' reaches TRNIDINO on this rejecting path or on any other. The decision still goes through the same FieldAttributeSetter the highlighting screens use and comes back untouched, which is why 'attributes' is present and empty rather than absent. This program's whole error signalling is the message line plus MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL, and -1 in an xxxL item is a CURSOR request and not a colour: it is reported as cursorField, because AAP section 0.3.9 makes an xxxL item validation and highlight metadata and never a payload member. DFHAID and DFHBMSCA are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository, so the AID this case names is a mnemonic reproduced by common.CicsAid - risk R-D. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): the whole 218-byte area travels in the payload and nothing is held server-side. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160 bytes and the CDEMO-CT01-INFO extension at :53-61 is 16 + 16 + 8 + 1 + 1 + 16 = 58, which is 218 in all; the extension is carried as its own field rather than folded into the 160-byte context all seventeen controllers share, and all 22 items are pinned so none is left unchecked. An item the passed area does not name keeps what its picture gives it - spaces for PIC X, zeros for PIC 9 - so CDEMO-CT01-NEXT-PAGE-FLG is blank rather than the 'N' of its VALUE clause at :57, because :98 overwrote WORKING-STORAGE with the caller's bytes. nextProgram carries COTRN01C because the task ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:429-430 binds TRANSACTION(CT01) to PROGRAM(COTRN01C), so the operator's next input returns to this same program; nextMapset and nextMap carry the COTRN01 and COTRN1A that the SEND at :219-225 names; and termination is RETURN_TRANSID rather than XCTL. There is no EXEC CICS XCTL on this path at all, so gate G40 is not discharged here and no transfer target is invented. THE DATASET, asserted twice over. The three rows are declared as inputs and pinned again, unchanged, in expectedFinalState with a dataset-level rowCount of 3 at the CVTRA05Y width of 350 - which is a real assertion on this path rather than bookkeeping, because :275 states the UPDATE option and a read with UPDATE takes a record lock. A translation that took the lock and then rewrote or deleted the record would be caught here and nowhere else in the response, and a translation that read through the non-locking path would be caught by the adapter. That is also the dataset-level half of risk R-B: the program is called TransactionAddController and TRANSACT is exactly as it was. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, READ-TRANSACT-FILE, SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO, cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY - 21 xxxI payload items summing to 416, so the group is 12 + 21 x 7 + 416 = 575 bytes) and the transaction definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G19 and G21 (the seeded and final-state images are the full 350 bytes CVTRA05Y declares, trailing FILLER X(20) included, so an omitted FILLER fails on width alone), G30 (both ordered EVALUATEs honoured in source order - EIBAID at :112 takes the first of its five arms, the figurative-constant test at :146 the second of its two, and the response check at :280 the second of its three, with WHEN OTHER last in each), G37, G38, G47 (the keyed read IS reached here and its NOTFND outcome is asserted, reached from seeded data rather than from a forced outcome) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this path has none of them: G23 (no monetary field is computed or painted - TRNAMTO is blank on this arm, and case16 and case17 are where the edited move is pinned), G32 (zero GO TO), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination), G40 (no XCTL) and G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC).
